'''Darth Fastus''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When Fastus heard about the [[Project Noble Focus|experiments]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to determine the strengths and weaknesses of various alien species, he sent a subordinate, [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Locke (Sith Empire)|Locke]], to investigate on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. With the Republic's research, Darth Fastus intended to create a perfect fighting specimen for the Empire by way of genetic manipulation.<ref name="TOR" />
